title: TagDuel End Phase persistence and restart idempotency

implementation.behavior: Each rotation persists the outgoing physical representative's seven-card End Phase discard, starts a fresh Node process against the same temporary SQLite database, restores that exact seat, commits one discard to six, advances to the incoming seat and draws exactly once, then retries the same action receipt without a second mutation.
implementation.validation: Parent and child processes use isolated temporary SQLite; the child reopens the saved TagDuel session, validates rules and physical ownership, executes actTag and retries the same request ID.

limitations: The restart is a child Node process using temporary SQLite, not a production process restart.
No live Discord guild, token, production database, or player record is used.
This validates a rules/persistence path and does not certify a new card.
